plain: A person who helps another commit a crime.

webster.text: An associate in a crime; a partner or partaker in guilt.

example.quote: In my opinion, till an accomplice's own danger is removed, his evidence ought to be regarded with great diffidence.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. IREDELL, July 28, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
